products.title: Smart Pet Feeder Camera 1080P HD
products.descriptionHtml:
See them. Feed them. From anywhere.

Mealtime becomes a moment of connection. This smart feeder pairs precise, scheduled portions with a crisp 1080P HD camera, so you can check in, watch them enjoy every bite and never miss a meal, wherever your day takes you.

  • Crystal-clear 1080P view – a live window into home, right on your phone.
  • Scheduled, portioned meals – consistent routines that support a healthy weight.
  • Peace of mind on long days – late meetings and weekends away, handled.
  • Elegant, minimal design – crafted to sit beautifully in a considered home.

Because caring for them should never depend on where you are.

products.title: Automatic Pet Feeder Smart Sensor
products.descriptionHtml:
Effortless nourishment, intelligently timed.

A feeder that thinks ahead. Smart sensing and automatic portioning keep fresh food ready on a dependable schedule, giving your companion the calm comfort of routine and giving you one less thing to remember.

  • Smart sensor technology – responsive, reliable dispensing.
  • Automatic portion control – the right amount, every time.
  • Routine they can rely on – steady mealtimes for a happier, calmer pet.
  • Clean, sculptural form – technology that disappears into your interior.

Thoughtful care, quietly running in the background.

products.title: Smart Mini GPS Pet Tracker
products.descriptionHtml:
Freedom for them. Reassurance for you.

Light enough to forget, smart enough to matter. This compact GPS tracker clips discreetly to their collar so every adventure ends with a reunion, and every worry ends with a glance at your phone.

  • Real-time location – know where they are, the moment you need to.
  • Featherlight, mini design – comfortable for pets of every size.
  • Discreet on the collar – understated, never in the way.
  • Confidence on every walk – explore more, worry less.

The smallest gesture of love, with the biggest peace of mind.

products.title: Premium Pet Water Fountain 68oz
products.descriptionHtml:
Fresh, flowing water. A healthier habit.

Pets are naturally drawn to moving water. This premium fountain keeps a generous 68oz (approx. 2L) of fresh, circulating water within reach all day, gently encouraging them to drink more and stay beautifully hydrated.

  • Generous 68oz capacity – fewer refills, always fresh.
  • Continuous gentle flow – inviting water pets love to drink.
  • Supports healthy hydration – a simple daily ritual of wellbeing.
  • Quiet, refined presence – calm enough for the most serene home.

Everyday care, elevated.

products.title: Laura Hill Electric Heated Blanket Double
products.descriptionHtml:
Slip into warmth, every single night.

Turn your bed into a sanctuary. Sized for a double bed, this electric heated blanket wraps you in soft, even warmth, so cold sheets become a memory and every night begins with comfort.

  • Double-bed size – generous warmth for one or two.
  • Soft, even heat – soothing comfort from edge to edge.
  • Pre-warm your bed – climb into cozy, not cold.
  • Soft-touch finish – luxurious against the skin.

The quiet luxury of a warm bed, waiting for you.

products.title: USB Powered Heated Blanket 3 Settings
products.descriptionHtml:
Your warmth, wherever you settle.

On the sofa, at your desk or on the road, this USB-powered heated blanket brings personal warmth anywhere there is a port. Three heat settings let you find exactly the right level of comfort.

  • USB powered – works with a laptop, power bank or adapter.
  • 3 heat settings – from a gentle glow to deeply cozy.
  • Portable and light – home office, car or reading nook.
  • Plush and soft – a little indulgence for everyday moments.

Small comfort, big difference.

products.title: Weighted Heated Blanket 9kg
products.descriptionHtml:
The embrace of weight. The comfort of warmth.

Two of the most soothing sensations, united. A calming 9kg of evenly distributed weight meets gentle, enveloping heat, creating a deeply grounding feeling that helps you unwind, let go and drift into restful sleep.

  • 9kg of even weight – a comforting, hug-like feel.
  • Gentle, enveloping heat – warmth that melts away the day.
  • Made for deep relaxation – evenings on the sofa or nights in bed.
  • Premium soft finish – indulgent from the first touch.

Our most luxurious way to wind down.

products.title: Pet-Specific Heated Blanket Washable
products.descriptionHtml:
Because they deserve to be cozy too.

Designed especially for pets, this heated blanket offers a gentle, comforting warmth that is ideal for chilly evenings, senior companions and pets who simply love to curl up. Washable, so it stays fresh and inviting.

  • Made for pets – gentle warmth suited to your companion.
  • Washable – easy to keep clean, fresh and hygienic.
  • Soothing comfort – lovely for older pets and cold-weather naps.
  • Soft and inviting – their new favourite spot in the house.

Warmth they will thank you for, in their own way.
